history.created_by: LABEL name=Vault K8s maintainer=Vault Team <vault@hashicorp.com> vendor=HashiCorp version=1.7.3 release=1.7.3 revision=d2fe28c6a30b061967bf310132a35fb737e925ee org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MPL-2.0 summary=The Vault-K8s binary includes first-class integrations between Vault and Kubernetes. description=Vault-K8s includes first-class integrations between Vault and Kuberentes. Integrations include the Vault Agent Injector mutating admission webhook.

RUN |5 PRODUCT_VERSION=1.7.3 PRODUCT_REVISION=d2fe28c6a30b061967bf310132a35fb737e925ee PRODUCT_NAME=vault-k8s TARGETOS=linux TARGETARCH=amd64 /bin/sh -c addgroup vault &&     adduser -S -G vault vault # buildkit

RUN |5 PRODUCT_VERSION=1.7.3 PRODUCT_REVISION=d2fe28c6a30b061967bf310132a35fb737e925ee PRODUCT_NAME=vault-k8s TARGETOS=linux TARGETARCH=amd64 /bin/sh -c set -eux &&     apk update &&     apk add --no-cache ca-certificates libcap su-exec iputils &&     apk upgrade --no-cache libcrypto3 # buildkit
mount / from exec apk add --no-cache libcap libcap-getcap libcap-setcap libcap-utils libcap2 libcrypto3 libssl3 musl musl-utils zlib
mount / from exec apk upgrade --no-cache libcap libcap-getcap libcap-setcap libcap-utils libcap2 libcrypto3 libssl3 musl musl-utils zlib
